title: Advanced lost civilization and ancient Egypt

tellings.quote: I'm in the Randall Carlson Graham Hancock school. I don't think this is our first goound. I think ancient Egypt is a great testament to that.

plain: Joe Rogan, a well-known podcast host, says he belongs to the school of Randall Carlson and Graham Hancock, writers who argue that an advanced human civilisation existed and was lost long before recorded history. Rogan says he does not think this is humanity's first time around, and that ancient Egypt is a great testament to that.
